summary_1line: Bhishma recounts teachings on detachment—Janaka’s indifference to loss and Vodhya’s six natural teachers illustrating freedom from desire and solitude.

image_candidates.scene_text: An osprey flying with a piece of meat in its beak is attacked by other birds until it drops the meat and escapes into peaceful flight.
A solitary arrow-maker works with intense concentration at his bench while a king’s procession passes unnoticed beside him.
A maiden stands quietly with a single shell anklet on her wrist, symbolizing solitude and the silence that comes from being alone.
